gloss: to relay; to transfer (a call); to act as intermediary

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {取次|とりつ}ぎませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {取次|とりつ}いでいなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {取次|とりつ}いでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to relay; to pass on (a message or visitor)
definitions.explanation: To serve as an intermediary by passing a message, request, or visitor along to the intended person.
To connect a caller to another person by transferring the call. A standard action in office and business phone etiquette.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{客様|きゃくさま}→お客様：08780_okyakusama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取次|とりつ}いで⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{伝言|でんごん}→伝言：03448_dengon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取次|とりつ}いで⟦もらえます→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Could you relay a message for me?

examples.japanese: ⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}えたら→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{担当者|たんとうしゃ}→担当者：09676_tantousha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{取次|とりつ}いで⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。

examples.english: One of the first things new employees should learn is how to transfer phone calls.

notes:
USAGE:
{取次|とりつ}ぐ is a transitive godan verb commonly encountered in business and office settings. The noun form {取次|とりつ}ぎ is also frequently used.

ASPECT (ている):
{取次|とりつ}いで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes the ongoing act of relaying or transferring.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取次|とりつ}ぐ (relay/connect a person)
- ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取次|とりつ}ぐ (transfer a call)
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{取次|とりつ}ぐ (transfer to someone)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取次|とりつ}ぐ (transfer a phone call)
- ⟦{来客|らいきゃく}→来客：13061_raikyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取次|とりつ}ぐ (show a visitor through)
- {取次|とりつ}ぎ⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧ (wholesale distribution)

The noun form {取次|とりつ}ぎ also refers to a distributor or wholesaler in the publishing industry.
